tasks.description: Ingest raw records from the upstream source into a staging area. This stage has no prerequisites and is the first stage in the pipeline. It should handle errors and exceptions properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given raw records from the upstream source, when the ingest stage is run, then the records are successfully stored in the staging area.

tasks.description: Validate the ingested records against the schema, rejecting malformed rows. This stage depends on the output of the ingest stage and should handle validation errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given ingested records, when the validate stage is run, then the records are validated against the schema and malformed rows are rejected.

tasks.description: Transform the validated records into the canonical internal format. This stage operates solely on the validated output and depends on the validate stage.
acceptance_criteria: Given validated records, when the transform stage is run, then the records are transformed into the canonical internal format.

tasks.description: Deduplicate the transformed records, removing exact and near-duplicate entries. This stage runs on the transformed output and depends on the transform stage.
acceptance_criteria: Given transformed records, when the deduplicate stage is run, then the records are deduplicated and exact and near-duplicate entries are removed.

tasks.description: Load the deduplicated records into the target warehouse. This stage consumes the deduplicated output and depends on the deduplicate stage.
acceptance_criteria: Given deduplicated records, when the load stage is run, then the records are loaded into the target warehouse.

tasks.description: Notify downstream consumers that fresh data is available. This stage fires only after a successful load and depends on the load stage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful load, when the notify stage is run, then downstream consumers are notified that fresh data is available.
